description: Nearest-rank percentile cases for the example benchmark suite. Each case is a labelled expectation against scripts/lib/percentile.mjs — the shared helper four scripts used to each reimplement (PR #159). The p argument is always on the 0-100 scale; an empty input answers null. No student data: these are arithmetic fixtures.

cases.label: p0 clamps to the first value
p95 of ten rounds up a rank
empty input is null, never zero
